mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining >0.25pp over 3 months, or Rank IC <0.03 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.5% for two consecutive months signals a shift to neutral monetary policy, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as markets price in stable rate environments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of FEDFUNDS>0.5% periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline indicate labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising PAYEMS/falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 5-day returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term coefficient negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1150 and RSAFS exceeding 450,000 in a high-demand regime signals robust consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: Signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC <0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rising INDPRO trend indicates manufacturing resilience and supply chain stability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through higher corporate profit visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of INDPRO rising periods (3-month change >0.5%), or Rank IC <0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth exceeding 2.5% annualized signals strong economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as markets react to near-term growth momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of GDPC1>2.5% periods, or Rank IC <0.05 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 3.0% in a high-inflation regime triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as markets price in central bank policy commitment despite inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >60% of CPIAUCSL>3.0% periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falling below 4.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of UNRATE<4.5% periods, or Rank IC <0.04 over 3-year windows.
